title.description: Header title of one game's stats screen.
title.notes: {{game}} is the translated game name, e.g. Sudoku.

a11y.back.description: Screen-reader label of the back button, which returns to the game.

tile.sessions.description: Tile label: how many games of this game the player finished, abandoned ones included.

tile.completed.description: Tile label: finished games that were not abandoned.

tile.wins.description: Tile label: number of games won.

tile.losses.description: Tile label: number of games lost.

tile.ties.description: Tile label: number of games tied (a push in Blackjack).

tile.winRate.description: Tile label: wins as a percentage of wins, losses and ties.

tile.currentStreak.description: Tile label: the player's current run of consecutive wins.

tile.bestStreak.description: Tile label: the player's longest run of consecutive wins.

tile.best.description: Tile label: the player's best result in this game, shown with its unit (e.g. 412 pts, 87 moves).

tile.timePlayed.description: Tile label: total reported play time in this game.

tile.lastPlayed.description: Tile label: the date of the player's last finished game.

empty.description: Shown when the player has not finished a game of this game yet.

error.description: Shown when the stats could not be loaded and none were loaded before.

offline.description: Shown when the device is offline and no stats were loaded before.

stale.description: Note above stats loaded earlier in this app session, shown when they could not be refreshed.

updating.description: Note above stats loaded earlier in this app session while the latest ones are being fetched.

retry.description: Button that tries loading the stats again.

link.leaderboard.description: Link that opens this game's leaderboard.

link.runHistory.description: Link (Blackjack only) that opens the on-device history of past runs.
link.runHistory.notes: A run is one Blackjack session from a starting bankroll to cash-out or bust.

outcome.completed.description: Outcome of a finished game that was played through to a natural end.
outcome.completed.notes: Shown next to the outcome's glyph in the Profile's Recent Games rows, and as the Outcome value on the game detail screen.

outcome.abandoned.description: Outcome of a finished game the player left before it ended.
outcome.abandoned.notes: Shown next to the outcome's glyph in the Profile's Recent Games rows, and as the Outcome value on the game detail screen.

outcome.kept_playing.description: Outcome of a finished game with no natural end that the player kept playing beyond a milestone (e.g. 2048's win tile).
outcome.kept_playing.notes: Shown next to the outcome's glyph in the Profile's Recent Games rows, and as the Outcome value on the game detail screen.

outcome.win.description: Outcome of a finished game: the player won.
outcome.win.notes: Shown next to the outcome's glyph in the Profile's Recent Games rows, and as the Outcome value on the game detail screen.

outcome.loss.description: Outcome of a finished game: the player lost.
outcome.loss.notes: Shown next to the outcome's glyph in the Profile's Recent Games rows, and as the Outcome value on the game detail screen.

outcome.push.description: Outcome of a finished game: a tie (a push in Blackjack).
outcome.push.notes: Shown next to the outcome's glyph in the Profile's Recent Games rows, and as the Outcome value on the game detail screen.

metric.score_one.description: A points value, singular. Short: shown in narrow columns.

metric.score_other.description: A points value, plural, e.g. "412 pts". Short: shown in narrow columns.

metric.moves_one.description: A move count, singular (FreeCell's best is the fewest moves).

metric.moves_other.description: A move count, plural, e.g. "87 moves".

metric.guesses_other.description: A guess count, plural (Daily Word), e.g. "3 guesses".

metric.chips_other.description: A chip count, plural (Blackjack), e.g. "1,450 chips".
